mapper.sql: admin_account a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.role_code,r.role_name FROM admin_account_role ar JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ar.admin_role_id WHERE ar.admin_account_id=#{accountId} AND r.enabled=1 ORDER BY r.role_sort,r.id
SELECT id,parent_id,menu_name,menu_type,permission_code,route_path,component_path,icon_name,visible,enabled,sort_no FROM admin_menu ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT DISTINCT rm.admin_menu_id FROM admin_account_role ar JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ar.admin_role_id AND r.enabled=1 JOIN admin_role_menu rm ON rm.admin_role_id=r.id WHERE ar.admin_account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_account SET last_login_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}
